subject: PrivDeploy: surge guardrails, observability SKU, and pilot exit credit options
messages:
From: Ethan Jones <ejones@opslyft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@opslyft.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PrivDeploy: surge windows + observability pricing + exit options

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the VPC flow looks solid. A couple of commercial questions from procurement/infra as we scope pilot sizing:

1) Surge pricing: we expect a 3–4x traffic spike during Black Friday-style events for a ~48 hour window. What does Redwood charge for short-term burst above committed throughput? Is there a grace or buffer we can negotiate for the pilot?

2) Observability addon: we want access to token-level tracing and full retention for 90 days during the pilot. Do you price that as a separate SKU by tokens, or is it part of the platform fee? Rough ballpark per-month estimate helps.

3) Exit / rollback credits: procurement asks what happens if we do a pilot commit and decide not to proceed within the first 6 months — any pro-rated credits or unwind mechanics?

Attaching our traffic forecast and a blank SOW template for context.

Appreciate a short write-up so we can share internally.

Thanks —
Ethan
Ethan Jones
Head of Infrastructure, OpsLyft

[Attachment: SOW_template.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Jones <ejones@opslyft.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy: surge windows + observability pricing + exit options

Hi Ethan — great questions, thanks for the context and the forecast. Below is a concise set of options and the trade-offs so you can pick what fits OpsLyft's risk profile. Attaching a short spreadsheet that lays out the math for the two pilot options.

Quick summary (pilot-focused):
- Option A — Pilot with included buffer: 3-month pilot, commit to 200qps baseline. We include a 20% surge buffer for no additional charge for the first 90 days. Bursts beyond buffer billed at 1.3x unit rate for the remainder of the pilot.
- Option B — Committed + surge-surcharge: commit to baseline only; bursts billed at 1.5x above baseline immediately. We offer a one-time 10% pilot discount on the platform fee if you take this option.

Observability / Tracing add-on:
- We price observability as an add-on SKU. For 90-day full retention with token-level tracing during a pilot of this scale, expect ~$6k–$9k/month (depends on average token ingestion). The spreadsheet uses your forecast to estimate $7,250/month. This includes ingestion, 90-day retention, and trace UI access.

Exit / rollback mechanics:
- If OpsLyft cancels within first 6 months, we propose a pro-rated conversion credit equal to 25% of remaining committed platform fee (not including usage/observability spend). This is intended to soften pilot risk while keeping a reasonable commercial midpoint.

Attachments: pilot-pricing-options.xlsx (breakouts), OpsLyft_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft with placeholders).

Next steps — would you prefer: 1) a short call tomorrow to pick A vs B and finalize SOW, or 2) we send a clean SOW + DocuSign link with Option A pre-selected?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot-pricing-options.xlsx]
[Attachment: OpsLyft_SOW_v1.pdf]

-----

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: PrivDeploy: surge windows + observability pricing + exit options (internal)

Marissa — quick internal note before we send final language to OpsLyft:

1) Surge buffer: 20% included for first 90 days is acceptable for sales-led pilots. For any pilot where we anticipate >2x sustained traffic we should require an explicit capacity check (SRE onboarding). Suggest we add a short clause: "temporary surge buffer subject to SRE review for sustained >2x utilization over 4 hours."

2) Observability SKU: legal wants the add-on to be explicitly billable monthly and not roll into platform fee wording. Also call-out that retention beyond 90 days will incur an additional storage charge.

3) Exit credit: finance sign-off needed on 25% pro-rated credit. If OpsLyft asks for a larger unwind (e.g., 50%), push for time-bound (only within first 90 days) or require termination fee.

I’ll loop in finance/legal if you want a one-pager. For the SOW, we should add a 30-day notification for cancellation and a clear formula for how pro-rata is calculated (remaining months * platform fee * 25%).

Irene
Director, Commercial Contracts

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Jones <ejones@opslyft.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@opslyft.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy: surge windows + observability pricing + exit options

Hi Ethan — following up with a concise proposal now that we aligned internally. I pulled the numbers from your forecast and the attached spreadsheet.

Proposal (recommend Option A for pilot):
- Baseline commit: 200 qps (pilot period: 3 months)
- Included surge buffer: 20% for first 90 days (no charge). Automated alerts and SRE review if sustained >2x baseline for 4+ hours.
- Burst billing beyond buffer: 1.3x per-unit usage rate (applies only after buffer and SRE sign-off).
- Observability: Add-on SKU priced at $7,250/month for the pilot scope (90-day retention, token-level traces).
- Exit / rollback: If OpsLyft cancels within first 6 months, Redwood grants a pro-rated credit equal to 25% of unused committed platform fee (calculation shown in SOW Section 4.3). Cancellation requires 30 days notice.
- One-time pilot concession: we will waive the SOW setup fee for pilots signed by Dec 15, 2026.

If that sounds good I can:
1) Draft a clean SOW with Option A pre-selected and send DocuSign (Irene approved the wording above; finance is good with 25% credit for pilots).
2) Or schedule a 30-minute call to walk OpsLyft procurement & infra through the SRE surge guardrails.

Proposed DocSend with redlined SOW: https://docsend.com/view/opslyft-privdeploy-sow (same link as above).

Thanks — we’re eager to get the pilot on the calendar.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
